sources.title: AnchorWeave - zunwang1.github.io
sources.snippet: AnchorWeave maintains world consistency over long camera trajectories. First frame (conditioning image) on top; generated video below. Starting from the 1st frame, AnchorWeave generates three 81-frame segments iteratively, each utilizing the memory from previous generations, which are then composed to form the full video. The backbone model is Wan2.2 5B.

sources.title: AnchorWeave: World-Consistent Video Generation with Retrieved Local ...
sources.snippet: The model generalizes effectively to diverse unseen scenarios, such as a wooden cabin, an alley, and a wooden sailing ship. While the visual backbone is limited to 81-frame video, AnchorWeave enables generation beyond this limit by conditioning each new segment on accumulated memory.

sources.snippet: Maintaining spatial world consistency over long horizons remains a central challenge for camera-controllable video generation. Existing memory-based approaches often condition generation on globally reconstructed 3D scenes by rendering anchor videos from the reconstructed geometry in the history.
